mapper.select:
select finprod_id as id, finprod_abbr as text from FIN_PRODUCT WHERE 1 = 1 and FINPROD_TYPE = 'F17'
AND ( finprod_id like concat_ws('','%',#{search},'%') OR finprod_abbr like concat_ws('','%',#{search},'%') )
GROUP BY finprod_id, finprod_abbr

select vfp.finprod_id as finprodId, vfp.finprod_abbr as finprodAbbr, fpt.type_1 as assetType, fpt.type_1 as assetTypeCode, vfp.FINPROD_TYPE as finprodType, DATE_FORMAT(vfp.vdate, '%Y-%m-%d') as vdate1, DATE_FORMAT(vfp.mdate, '%Y-%m-%d') as mdate1, vfp.profit_type as profitType, vfp.profit_type as profitTypeCode, cast(vccr.yield as char)*100 as currentquotation,
(case when vfp.profit_type = '02' then vccr.basis else '' end)as basic, vfp.issuer as issuer FROM FIN_PRODUCT vfp left join fin_product_type fpt on vfp.finprod_id = fpt.finprod_id left join (select vccr.* from fin_CASH_CALC_RULE vccr where 1 = 1 and vccr.eff_date = (select max(cash_rule.eff_date) from fin_CASH_CALC_RULE cash_rule where cash_rule.finprod_id = vccr.finprod_id and cash_rule.finprod_type = vccr.finprod_type)) vccr on vfp.finprod_id = vccr.finprod_id and vfp.finprod_type = vccr.finprod_type where vfp.FINPROD_TYPE = 'F17'
AND vfp.finprod_id in
#{bond}
AND vfp.profit_type in
#{profitType}
AND fpt.type_1 in
#{assetType}
AND vfp.vdate >= STR_TO_DATE(#{vDateBegin},'%Y-%m-%d')
AND vfp.vdate <= STR_TO_DATE(#{vDateEnd},'%Y-%m-%d')
AND vfp.mdate >= STR_TO_DATE(#{mDateBegin},'%Y-%m-%d')
AND vfp.mdate <= STR_TO_DATE(#{mDateEnd},'%Y-%m-%d')
ORDER BY vccr.eff_date desc
